newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Mining raises indium price by 3,000 yen/kg.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Mining raises indium price by 3,000 yen/kg.

text.p: Nippon Mining and Metals Co said on Monday it raised its selling price for indium ingot by 3,000 yen to 29,000 yen per kg for large orders and 34,000 yen per kg for small orders for 99.99 percent pure metal, effective with January 28 shipments.
It cited a recovery in domestic demand as the reason for the price hike, which followed a steady, steep slide in indium prices last year.
